Yes. In simple terms, there are 3 main ways to start:

Toppings
These are the easiest all-round option. You can sprinkle them on porridge, yogurt, bowls, desserts, or mix a little into a drink. A good beginner pick is the Bio-Rohkakao Topping Probierpaket if you want to try a few flavors.

Boosters
These are for a stronger, more functional effect. Wild Charge is a cacao-based blend with guarana, maca, and kola nut for a morning energy ritual. Kokos Booster is a lighter coconut-water-based option with guarana and beetroot for hydration and a natural lift. Both contain natural caffeine.

Bars
These are the simplest grab-and-go choice. The Bio-Rohriegel Probierbox is easy if you just want a ready-to-eat snack and try two flavors.
